recommendation_summary: Wrap the existing cron command on edna in a short shell script that, on any non-zero exit, sends the existing summary email with stderr in the body.

labels.Requirements and who asked: You, after nightly-sync crashed four nights on an expired token and sent no mail: know when that job dies. You proposed a central log on the Synology, maybe in Docker.
labels.Deleted: A Synology central log and a Docker logging stack. You will not read logs, so stored logs leave the same silence.
labels.Bottleneck: The summary email is sent only after startup succeeds, and nothing else alerts on this job.
labels.Checked myself: What you told me about edna, the 03:00 cron, the four startup crashes, and the NAS. I have not inspected the script or either machine.

note: The reply recommends one failure-mail wrapper, which fits SMALL. It doesn't catch the case where cron never starts the job at all.
